description: This file defines an ErrorBoundary React component in TypeScript, used to catch JavaScript errors in the component tree, display an error message, and offer options to report the error or reset stored data.

classes.name: ErrorBoundary
classes.description: A React component that acts as an error boundary to catch JavaScript errors in its child components, display an error message, and provide options to report the error or reset local data.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component state with error handling flags.

methods.name: componentDidCatch
methods.description: React lifecycle method that captures errors and updates the component state.

methods.name: clearAndSaveData
methods.description: Exports current sync store data and clears local storage, then reloads the page.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders either an error message with options or the child components.
